title: priestley-space
description: A compact, totally order-disconnected partially ordered topological space - the Priestley dual that, via the twist product, realizes the bilattice's predication-fiber algebra as the spatial side of Priestley/Jung-Rivieccio duality.

points.description: the underlying set of points (the prime filters of the dual distributive lattice)

order.description: a partial order on the points

topology.description: a topology whose clopen up-sets recover the dual distributive lattice

totallyOrderDisconnected.description: for any x not<= y there is a clopen up-set containing x but not y
